title: The 8-Ton Door Nuclear Missile Officers Live Behind
asof: Figures from US Air Force & National Park Service · full video on the channel

shots.s: Two officers ride an elevator sixty feet under the prairie.
At the bottom: a blast door weighing eight tons.
It can only be opened from inside.
A voice shouts clear. You shout back.
Behind it, a capsule the size of a bedroom.
This is where crews watch over ten Minuteman Three missiles.
Nobody can be in here alone. It's a no-lone zone.
Could you spend a day behind that door?
